description: B-228 as an object rule, B-1253: a Combat match on the Infiltration arena (a campaign stage hosted as an arena loads the stage's own scenario) creates the stage's 4 lifts once, in the main pass, through the objects.json row rule "multiplayer": true, and the ROM-era SP-in-MP overlay does not run (it created them a second time).

input_sequence.comment: boot, seed the Combat Simulator config and start the match through the debug launch path
after the stage load, setupCreateProps and a few gameplay frames
